title: Theophysics Lean Kernel Verified Section-by-Section Report

canonical_node.axiom: A formal kernel defines a product-collapse architecture over a coherence algebra with zero, one, multiplication, identity, zero-annihilation, one_ne_zero, and no_zero_divisors, and a zero-preserving operator C, such that a product is zero iff zero is a factor.
definitions: CoherenceAlgebra: algebraic structure with zero, one, mul, identity laws, zero-annihilation, one_ne_zero, no_zero_divisors.
listProd: recursive product of a finite list; empty list maps to one.
CoherenceOperator: structure with apply map and preserves_zero law.
Regime: two states constructive and destructive; grace maps both to constructive.
LawModel: packages state type, value map, collapse predicate, and proof that collapsed states map to zero.
LawIso: requires maps both ways, inverse laws, value preservation, collapse preservation.
MasterState: contains factor list and C operator; rawChi is list product; chi is operator-applied rawChi.
derivation: listProd_eq_zero_of_mem_zero: if zero in list, product is zero.
mem_zero_of_listProd_eq_zero: if product is zero, zero in list.
listProd_eq_zero_iff: product zero iff zero in list.
listProd_ne_zero_of_all_ne_zero: if all factors nonzero, product nonzero.
cannot_rescue_zero: zero-preserving operator sends zero to zero.
zero_if_any_factor_zero: if any factor zero, C applied after product yields zero.
grace_not_invertible: no total inverse for grace.
rawChi_zero_iff, chi_zero_if_any_factor_zero, rawChi_nonzero_if_all_factors_nonzero: master state inherits collapse logic.
canonical_node.action: Treat the verified kernel as establishing a formal collapse architecture, not as proof of theological or physical truth. Use it as a rigorous foundation for future law models and isomorphisms, requiring explicit LawModel and LawIso instances for any concrete claims.

plain_summary: This report documents a Lean-verified kernel for a product-collapse architecture. It proves that a product is zero iff zero is a factor, and that a zero-preserving operator preserves collapse. It defines law slots, a grace map, and rigorous burdens of proof for law models and isomorphisms. The kernel is clean (no sorry/axiom) but does not by itself prove theological or physical truth; it provides a formal foundation for future concrete models.
